summary: Wednesday's session could see some relief as US futures rebound sharply from Friday's AI rout, though Indian banks and metals carry Monday's heavy losses into the holiday.

detail.leaders: IT, which rose against Monday's sell-off and could gain further if the US tech rebound holds
detail.laggards: Banks and metals, which took the heaviest losses on Monday
detail.tone: A forward read for Wednesday 25 November, since markets are shut on Tuesday. Monday ended in a sharp sell-off, but a strong rebound in US futures this evening softens the outlook.
watch: Whether Wall Street holds its rebound through the US session and into Tuesday
Monday's provisional FII figures, not yet published
